name: cockpit
description: A denser Claude Code status line and a pane of the files this session produced, with a palette picker.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Colors for the status line and the files pane. "ansi" uses your terminal's own 16 colors and works without truecolor.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: "nerd" draws the file and clock icons from a Nerd Font; "plain" uses words, for terminals without one.
